observations: Photo shows stacked IBC (Intermediate Bulk Container) tote tanks: white/cream plastic bottle enclosed in a galvanized steel cage frame, sitting on a wooden pallet base.
Visible surface rust spots on the metal cage bars.
Black rubber/foam corner padding visible on the cage at top and bottom.
Wooden pallet looks weathered, sitting directly on bare dirt ground.
Background shows additional stacked tanks and other drums/containers, suggesting a dealer yard.
No brand, model, capacity marking, or manufacturer plate is legible anywhere in the frame.
A watermark reads 'POSTED ON JIJI U Z GLOBAL TECHNICAL' across the tank, which is a seller/platform tag, not a product label.
No shot of the bottom valve/outlet, the top cap, or any interior view of the plastic bottle.

identity.kind: IBC tote tank (1000L-class, caged plastic chemical/liquid storage tank)

claims.claim: The tank is suitable for storing various types of chemicals, including acids, alkalis, and corrosive materials.
claims.evidence: No material/resin code, manufacturer plate, or chemical-compatibility label is visible in photo 0; this is a seller assertion about a used item with unknown prior contents.

risks.risk: Unknown prior contents of a used IBC (could have held fuel, oil, or hazardous chemical residue), which affects safety and resale use.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the manufacturer/UN certification plate on the cage and any residue/odor disclosure from the seller.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown-history used tank, not food/chemical-grade certified

risks.risk: Hairline cracks, UV embrittlement, or stress marks on the plastic bottle not visible through the cage bars.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the bottle surface from multiple angles, especially corners and base.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unverified structural integrity, i.e. worst case

risks.risk: Cage corrosion extent beyond the visible surface rust could weaken structural support when filled.
risks.proof: Clear photos of all cage welds/joints and any deeper rust or bent bars.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-to-moderate rust, worst case structural risk

risks.risk: Bottom valve/outlet condition (cracked, missing, or seized) is not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of the bottom discharge valve assembly.
risks.if_unproven: priced as valve not confirmed functional

risks.risk: Pallet (wood or plastic skid) may be rotten or broken, affecting forklift handling and stacking.
risks.proof: Photo of the pallet underside and corners.
risks.if_unproven: priced as pallet condition unverified, assume replacement needed

risks.risk: Actual liquid capacity (commonly 1000L but could vary) is not confirmed by any readable marking.
risks.proof: Close-up of the capacity marking/plate on the cage or bottle shoulder.
risks.if_unproven: priced at lower-common-capacity assumption until confirmed

proof_requests: Close-up of the manufacturer/UN certification plate on the cage, showing capacity and material code.
Photo of the bottom discharge valve and cap.
Full unobstructed shots of the plastic bottle surface (front, back, both sides) without the cage blocking view.
Photo of the pallet base and underside.
Seller disclosure of what the tank previously contained, if known.
response.reason: This is clearly identifiable by type as a used IBC tote tank in a cage with visible cosmetic rust and no verifiable chemical-grade certification or condition proof, so it can be priced at worst case as a generic used IBC with unconfirmed history pending the listed proofs.
